headline: Colonials Regain Ground in Weathered Expanse; Berm Balance Tilts
war_summary: Since the last edition went to press, the Weathered Expanse has swung sharply: what stood at six Warden holdings to one Colonial now reads four Colonial against three Warden, with two posts still in ruin, and two-hour casualty rates there have climbed steeply. Palantine Berm remains the day's busiest front — fifty ownership actions in twenty-four hours, thirteen in the last two, with Vendett the most contested post — and the balance has shifted back to the Colonials, four bases to three. On the Nevish Line the Wardens advanced to seven holdings against one, both sides bleeding at nearly 380 losses an hour. Linn Mercy's map is unchanged at nine Colonial, one Warden and one ruin, but the daily toll has swollen past ten thousand Colonial and eighteen thousand Warden, the heaviest exchange centered on Outwich Ranch. In the Gutter, Suojus is back in Warden hands, the region once more wholly theirs. Marban Hollow's Checkpoint Bua, twenty-eight changes in a day, has gone silent these two hours; Mooring County and Kuura Strand likewise rest. Day 595 of the war; thirty-four victory towns required; no victor named.
